caveats: Erica Reynolds case: warrantless body-cavity search by Officer Timaree Murphy on Dec 26, 2018. No formal lawsuit appears in the sources; Reynolds filed a $12.5M notice of claim in June 2019 and the city settled for $1.6M (council approved Dec 2019; one source says Dec 18, another Dec 19). year_filed=2019 refers to the notice of claim, and 'civilian' is the closest lawsuit_type fit. Officer Murphy received a 40-hour suspension but no criminal charges are mentioned in any source, hence none_filed.
